features: Reliable Brand Support: IKALL is a trusted and reputable brand in the mobile and electronics industry since 2011, with over 2000 service centers across India. The IKALL K3310 comes with a 1-year warranty on the handset and 6 months warranty on accessories for complete peace of mind

Efficient Performance: With 32MB RAM and 32MB internal storage, the IKALL K3310 smoothly supports essential daily functions. Expandable memory up to 8GB allows you to store your favorite music and videos. Dual SIM support ensures seamless network connectivity

Long-lasting Battery: Powered by a 1000 mAh battery, the IKALL K3310 delivers long talk time of 5–6 hours and up to 3 days of standby time. The efficient battery performance keeps you connected throughout the day

User-friendly Keypad: Designed with comfortable, raised keypad buttons and enlarged fonts, the IKALL K3310 makes calling and texting easy, especially for senior citizens. The ergonomic and palm-friendly design enhances usability

Compact and Lightweight Design: Featuring a 1.8-inch display with 128x160 pixel resolution, the IKALL K3310 is compact, lightweight, and easy to carry. Its slim profile fits comfortably in your pocket and offers a firm grip
